result:
The users page now has a search box, a role filter and an Export CSV button. I haven't run the app, tests, lint or the type-check, as you asked.

- **Search:** it matches the full name or the email, ignoring case.
- **Role filter:** a dropdown with All roles, ADMIN and USER. It combines with the search.
- **Export CSV:** downloads `users.csv` with the columns Name, Email, Role and Joined. It contains only the users currently shown, so it follows the search and role filter. The button is disabled when no users match.
- **Joined column:** the date uses `formatDate`, so it reads like "March 4, 2026 3:10 PM", the same as the table.
- **Spreadsheet safety:** every CSV cell is quoted. A cell that starts with `=`, `+`, `-` or `@` gets a leading `'`, so a spreadsheet won't run it as a formula.
- **Admin-only:** the route already wraps `UsersList` in an admin-only `Authorization`, so only admins see the new controls.

The changes are in `features/users/components/users-list.tsx` and a new `utils/csv.ts` with the CSV and download helpers. The filtering runs in the browser on the list already loaded, so I didn't change the API or the mock handler.

The existing `Input` and `Select` components were built around `react-hook-form`, so I pass them an empty or minimal `registration` prop. The `Select` has no `value` prop. It works as an uncontrolled field, so it isn't tied to the filter state. I'd check the filter dropdown first when you run it.
